question: Using the sales data, what is the median value of total sales made in countries where the number of customers is greater than 4?
sql:
WITH country_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Country, SUM(i.Total) as total_sales 
    FROM invoices i 
    JOIN customers c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId 
    GROUP BY c.Country
),
country_customer_counts AS (
    SELECT Country, COUNT(*) as customer_count 
    FROM customers 
    GROUP BY Country
),
filtered_totals AS (
    SELECT ct.total_sales, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY ct.total_sales) as quartile 
    FROM country_totals ct
    JOIN country_customer_counts ccc ON ct.Country = ccc.Country
    WHERE ccc.customer_count > 4
)
SELECT AVG(total_sales) as median_sales FROM filtered_totals WHERE quartile IN (2, 3)
